# Frozen bridge connection data

`frozen.json` uses schema 1 and preserves fourteen accepted full before/after observations plus two additional source cells. Each case carries its source archive SHA256 and receipt location. Geometry indices describe the observed instance and never select runtime policy.

Positions, float32 bit witnesses, ordered face rings, edge rows, tags, adjacency and both selection orders are observed. Attributes and effective segments in the original fourteen are observed scalar operands. Fields named `derived` correlate original identity and unchanged geometry. Missing metadata and clean defaults remain unknown in private provenance; static sampling predictions are separate from observations.

The private task 20261600 field map and independent promotion verifier bind every mapped field to its original receipt. This is replayable DATA preparation; no product parity or runtime acceptance is claimed.

`tangent_witnesses.json` schema 1 contains 24 typed records: 23 captured rail fits and one captured group adjustment. The group record's fallback tangent vectors are labeled static-law predictions; they are not captured fit outputs. Numeric source indices identify selected source rows. This fixture prepares kernel validation and does not claim production parity.
